uci_rule: If domain is an IP address → −1 (phishing); else → 1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 1.

transform: PhiUSIIL is numeric char count. Recode: ≥75 →−1, 54–74 →0, <54 →1.
uci_rule: URL length ≥ 75 → −1; 54–74 → 0; < 54 → 1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 2.
Dots in domain: 1 → 1; 2 → 0; ≥ 3 → −1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 7.

transform: PhiUSIIL: IsHTTPS=1 (has HTTPS) →1; 0 →−1. UCI also uses cert issuer and age (0 = suspicious); approximate.
uci_rule: HTTPS + trusted issuer + age ≥ 1 yr → 1; HTTPS + untrusted → 0; no HTTPS → −1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 8.
Favicon loaded from same domain → 1; external → −1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 10.
iframe tag present → −1; absent → 1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 23.
Popup window with text fields → −1; else → 1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 22. Note: PhiUSIIL counts all popups, UCI checks for input fields — approximate.

transform: PhiUSIIL max is 1, so using count ≥ 1 → 1; 0 → 0. UCI Redirect is 0/1 (≤1 redirect vs ≥2). PhiUSIIL only records 0 or 1 redirects so this is approximate.
uci_rule: Redirect count ≥ 4 → 1 (phishing); ≤ 1 → 0. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 19. Adapted: PhiUSIIL max redirect is 1, so threshold lowered to ≥1.

transform: PhiUSIIL: 1 (form posts to external domain) →−1; 0 →1. UCI SFH also has 0 for 'about:blank'; we map to binary only.
uci_rule: SFH is blank ('about:blank') → −1; SFH refers to different domain → 0; same domain → 1. Source: Mohammad et al., 2014, Rule 16. Approximation: PhiUSIIL binary does not distinguish blank vs external.
